<?php
class QuietMapEmptyValue {
    public function __destruct() { global $reader, $selector, $key, $weak; echo "VALUE;"; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; $key = null; echo $weak->get() === null ? "KEY_GONE;" : "BAD_KEY;"; }
}
class QuietMapEmptyGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $key; echo "G;"; $map = new WeakMap; $map[$key] = new QuietMapEmptyValue; return $map; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$key = new stdClass;
$weak = WeakReference::create($key);
$reader = new QuietMapEmptyGet;
$selector = "value";
$destination = 42;
$destination = empty($reader->$selector);
echo $destination === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
$weak = null;
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietMapEmptyValue {
    public function __destruct() { global $reader, $selector, $key, $weak; echo "VALUE;"; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; $key = null; echo $weak->get() === null ? "KEY_GONE;" : "BAD_KEY;"; throw new Exception("map-value"); }
}
class QuietMapEmptyGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $key; echo "G;"; $map = new WeakMap; $map[$key] = new QuietMapEmptyValue; return $map; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$key = new stdClass;
$weak = WeakReference::create($key);
$reader = new QuietMapEmptyGet;
$selector = "value";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = empty($reader->$selector); echo "BAD_DELIVERY;"; }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo "CAUGHT;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_DESTINATION;";
echo $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
$weak = null;
echo "DONE;";
